s: Birkat hammazon al kos shelishi ubo t' seipim: achar akilat haapiqoman tzarik limzog kos shelishi lebarek alayv birkat hammazon. Veap lehaomerim shebbirkat hammazon enah teuna kos, mikkol maqom hoil vetiqqenu chakamim lishtot d' kosot belayla zeh — yesh laasot mitzva bekol echad veechad, veal hashshelishi yebarek al mezono. (Veim lo asa ken — lo yatza yede chobat d' kosot, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"b):

Kos zeh tzarik ledaqdeq bo im hu naqi mishshiyyure kosot, dehaynu shiyyure yayin sheshshara bo pat, sheim eno naqi tzarik shetipa vahadacha o leqannecho yapeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g. Veap mi sheeno nizhar bazeh kol hashshana (lepi shebbirkat hammazon en tzarik kos meiqqar haddin), mikkol maqom belayla zeh tzarik lizzaher:

Achar sheshshata kos zeh asur lishtot yayin o shear mashqeh hamshakker ad kos harebii, shemma yishtakker veyishshan veyimmana miqqeriat gemar hahallel. Veap mimmashqeh sheeno meshakker yesh limnoa, mittaam shennitbaer besiman ta"ch, chutz mimmayim vekayyotze bahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tp"a:

Abal kos zeh hashshelishi yakol lishtoto kullo apillu machaziq harbeh yoter merebiit, vaapillu mapsiq harbeh peamim beemtza shetiyyat hakkos, ap al pi ken hakkol nechshab lekos echad, apillu shoheh mittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sop shetiyya acharona yoter mikkede akilat peras. Umikkol maqom, im hakkos machaziq harbeh yoter midday — lo yishtennu kullo shello yishtakker:

Vaapillu bekos qatan, im shata mimmennu rob rebiit o yoter vehaya bedato shello lishtot od mimmennu veachar kak nimlak lachazor velishtot od mimmennu, kevan shetztzarik lebarek beraka rishona al mah sherotzeh lishtot — asur lo lishtot mimmennu (o mikkos acher) apillu eno yayin ella shear mashqeh shehu chamar medina, mippene shennireh kemosip al hakkosot shettiqqenu chakamim, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"g:

Mitzva lachazor achar zimmun laamirat hahallel kede lomar "hodu" bishlosha, dehaynu shehaechad yomar lashshenayim sheimmo "hodu laHashem vego'" vehem yaanu acharayv "hodu laHashem vego'", veken be"anna Hashem vego'", kemo shennitbaer besiman tk"b, ayyen sham hattaam. Vehaggadol shebbahen hu omer "hodu" vehashshenayim haqqetannim mimmennu onim acharayv. Veyakol haggadol litten reshut laqqatan. Vaapillu im otan hashshenayim akelu bebayit acher ukebar qareu et hahallel leatzman — mitztorpin lezimmun lehallel. Umikkol maqom, mi sheen shenayim okelin immo babbayit — en tzarik lachazor achar shelosha anashim mibbayit acher, ella day beishto ubanayv shehiggiu lechinnuk sheyyaanu acharayv. Veap shellekattechilla mitzva min hammubchar lomar "hodu" ve"anna" beg' anashim shehiggiu liklal mitzvot, mikkol maqom en tzarik lehaqpid kol kak bishbil zeh litroach acharehem ulehabiam mibbayit acher, ella day beishto ubanayv shehiggiu lechinnuk. Veyakol litten reshut leqatan lomar "anna vego'" vehu yaaneh acharayv. Abal "hodu" lo yaaneh achar haqqatan, ella yatchil hu beatzmo vehaqqatan yaaneh acharayv, lepi she"hodu" hu techillat happereq ukeshehaqqatan matchil vehu oneh acharayv — nireh keillu haqqatan hu shelucho, vetabo lo meera shemmebazzeh et qono laasot lo sheluchim kaelu. Umikkol maqom, "yomar na yisrael" ve"yomru na bet aharon" ve"yomru na yire Hashem", im amaram haqqatan vehu oneh acharayv "hodu laHashem vego'" — ap bediabad lo yatza yede chobato, ella im ken chazar veamar gam ken bipne atzmo "yomar na vego'", abal eno yotze bemah sheshshama mehaqqatan, kevan shehaqqatan hu patur mikkol hammitzvot shebbattora veeno chayyab bahem ella (middibre soperim) kede lechanneko bemitzvot:

Abal yakol litten reshut leishto lomar "hodu" ve"yomar na" ve"yomru na", vehu yaaneh achareha "hodu", veyetze yede chobato bemah sheshshomea mimmenna "yomar na" ve"yomru na vego'", sheap shehannashim peturot mikkol hallel, kemo shennitbaer besiman tk"b — behallel zeh chayyabot, veen shum chilluq benehen laanashim bekol mah shennoheg belayla zeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"b:

Vekol zeh be"hodu" shebbehallel zeh, abal le"hodu" shebbehallel haggadol en tzarik zimmun kelal. Veken lebirkat hammazon en tzarik lachazor achar zimmun. Vehannohagin latzet mibbattehem lebet chabrehem lebarek sham birkat hammazon bezimmun — hu minhag burut. Vegam yesh issur baddabar im yotzein mibbattehen achar akilat apiqoman, sheasur lahem litom kelum babbayit shehaleku lesham, veim ken haek yebareku sham birkat hammazon? Halo birkat hammazon tzarik lebarek bimqom gemar haakila. Vei epshar lahem lachazor veleekol haapiqoman babbayit shehaleku lesham, sheen okelin apiqoman beb' meqomot apillu lo akal bammaqom harishon kezayit. Ella im hem rotzim yeleku lesham qodem akilat apiqoman, veyoklu sham haapiqoman, vibareku sham birkat hammazon vehallel bezimmun. O yoklu haapiqoman vibareku birkat hammazon bebetam, veachar kak yeleku lesham im yirtzu lomar hallel bezimmun shelosha anashim:

Nahagu shebbaal habbayit haomer hahaggada hu mebarek birkat hammazon belayla zeh ap im yesh sham oreach, shenneemar (ve)"tob ayin hu yeborak" chaser va"v, kelomar "yebarek", velamedu chakamim mikkan sheen notenin lebarek birkat hammazon ella lemi shehu "tob ayin", ubelayla zeh niqra baal habbayit haomer hahaggada "tob ayin", sheomer "kol dikpin yete veyekol". Umikkol maqom, yakol litten reshut lebarek leacher:
